description: /aitmpl opens the aitmpl.com catalog in a side pane: session.start registers the command, command.run scans what is installed and opens the pane, ui.render on the Pane draws search, type filters, Installed and Popular/Results with downloads and open-on-site buttons, turn.complete rescans, ui.close tracks the pane; the catalog JSON is fetched live through $.http.fetch and cached for the session
